mug.title: Hand-Thrown Speckled Stoneware Mug, Ocean Blue Glaze
mug.description: A wheel-thrown stoneware mug with a deep ocean-blue glaze that breaks to cream over the speckled clay body. Comfortable C-handle, slightly flared rim, and an unglazed foot ring. Holds about 12 oz. Each piece is one of a kind, so glaze pooling varies.

vase.title: Small Bud Vase, Matte White with Raw Clay Neck
vase.description: A petite bottle-shaped bud vase in matte white glaze, with the raw terracotta clay left exposed at the neck. Sized for a single stem or a few dried grasses. Glazed inside so it holds water. About 6 inches tall.

bowl.title: Nesting Serving Bowl, Sage Green Celadon
bowl.description: A wide, shallow serving bowl in a translucent sage-green celadon glaze over porcelain. Great for salads, fruit, or as a centerpiece. Food safe and lead free. Roughly 9 inches across and 3 inches deep.
